title: Condition
description: A state a creature is in that changes what it may do: this one, poisoned, from the spider's bite, until it saves. The states themselves are codes rather than records; what is recorded here is that one of them holds. Read as FHIR reads a Condition: a subject, a code, and the span it holds for.

severity.description: How far it has gone, where the rules count degrees. Exhaustion has levels; most conditions have none.

cause.description: What put them in it: the creature, the spell, the trap.

onset.description: When it took hold, in the world's own time.

abatement.description: When it lifted. Absent while it still holds.

endsOn.description: What lifts it, for a condition the rules let a creature shake off.

save.description: The saving throw that ends it.

when.description: When it may be attempted, in the rules' own words: at the end of each of its turns.
